description: Fall occurs Monday afternoon; followed up Tuesday morning and reviewed in care plan on Wednesday.

notes.text: Resident found on floor in dining hall at 14:00. Transfer belt applied, assisted by two staff.
Post-fall assessment completed for dining hall fall. Vital signs stable, no hematoma or laceration.
Reviewed yesterday's dining room fall with physical therapist. Gait instability noted.
Interdisciplinary care plan meeting: reviewed fall earlier this week. Low bed and motion sensor ordered.

description: Overnight fall followed by periodic monitoring confirms no further incidents.

notes.text: Resident found sitting on floor beside bed at approx 0200. Call light was unplugged.
Post-fall assessment completed: resident denies pain, alert and oriented x 4.
Hourly safety rounding conducted. Resident sleeping quietly in bed. No further falls noted overnight.
Morning shift report: no additional falls or balance loss during shift since 0200 incident.

description: CNA and Nurse disagree on whether fall was witnessed and whether resident struck head.

notes.text: CNA report: Resident slipped and fell in bathroom at 11:00. Unwitnessed. Resident states she hit back of head.
RN evaluation: Clarification—fall was witnessed by dietary aide. Resident explicitly denies hitting head. Zero hematoma, pupils equal.
Post-fall neurological check recorded: vital signs stable, GCS 15. Contradiction regarding head trauma documented for MD review.

description: Two residents in Room 204. Resident A falls at 03:00; Resident B ambulates without incident at 03:15.

notes.text: Room 204 Bed A: Resident Alice found sitting on floor beside bed at 03:00. RN notified.
Room 204 Bed A: Post-fall assessment completed for Alice. Denies pain, ROM intact.
Room 204 Bed B: Roommate Betty awake and asking for water. Assisted to bathroom, ambulated safely with walker. No fall.
Room 204 Bed B: Betty tripped over footstool at 09:45 and fell to carpeted floor. New incident initiated.

description: Routine shift logs (meals, medication, physical therapy) surrounding a single fall at 15:30.

notes.text: Morning medications administered with applesauce. Tolerated well. Vital signs: BP 122/80.
Lunch tray served. Resident consumed 75% of meal. Voided x 1 in toilet with assist.
Resident fell in hallway near elevator at 15:30 while walking unassisted. Slipped on clean dry floor.
Comprehensive post-fall assessment completed: vitals stable, bilateral extremities checked, zero head trauma.
Dinner tray delivered. Resident resting comfortably in armchair. Ice pack applied to bruised knee as ordered.

description: Single overnight fall with 5 notes logged across CNA, Night RN, Day Charge Nurse, and MD review.

notes.text: Resident found sitting on floor beside bed at approx 0300. Call bell was not within reach. CNA notified charge RN.
Post-fall assessment completed for 0300 fall. Resident denies head strike or pain. Assisted back to bed via safe mechanical transfer.
Neuro check recorded following 0300 incident. Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72. Pupils equal and reactive.
Shift handover: Day shift briefed on resident's overnight fall near bed. Continued 15-minute safety monitoring in place.
Attending physician visited to evaluate resident following early morning fall. ROM full in all extremities, zero neurological deficits.

description: Resident experiences two separate falls on the same day: one at 06:15 and a second at 18:30.

notes.text: Resident found sitting on floor beside bed at 06:15. Stated slippers caught on rug.
Post-fall assessment completed for 0615 bedside fall. Resident uninjured.
Resident fell near dining room corridor at 18:30 during dinner transport. Assisted by dietary aide. New incident report opened.
Post-fall assessment and neuro check recorded for evening dining room incident. Ice pack applied to left wrist.

INC_B01_1.required_quote_substring: Post-fall assessment completed for 0615 bedside fall

description: Incident reported but no post-fall assessment or neurological check documented.

notes.text: Resident found on floor near lounge chair at 16:00. Assisted back to chair by nursing assistant.
Resident resting in chair watching television. Dinner tray served.

description: Assessment noted ambiguously without details ('Resident checked after fall, seemed ok').

notes.text: Resident slipped and fell in physical therapy room at 12:00.
Staff looked over resident after fall, appeared uninjured, returned to room.

INC_E04.required_quote_substring: Staff looked over resident after fall

description: Bathroom slip with delayed incident documentation and late administrative filing.

notes.text: Resident slipped on wet bathroom tile at approx 08:50 while ambulating unassisted. Slipped and fell to knees.
Comprehensive post-fall assessment completed: bilateral knees examined, slight erythema left patella, no hematoma.
Formal incident report filed for morning bathroom slip. Maintenance notified regarding leaking plumbing.

description: Outdoor patio fall witnessed by activity staff and followed up by nursing.

notes.text: Activity coordinator reports resident tripped over walkway curb in garden patio at 14:00. Fell onto grassy surface.
Post-fall assessment executed by floor nurse. Resident alert, oriented x 3. Denies dizziness prior to fall.
Family notified via telephone regarding patio fall. Daughter updated on vital signs and absence of injury.

description: Three falls across 48 hours in distinct locations (lounge, bedroom, hallway).

notes.text: Resident lost balance in TV lounge and slipped to floor at approx 10:15.
Post-fall assessment completed for lounge incident. Range of motion intact.
Night shift reports resident found lying on floor beside bed at 02:00.
Post-fall neurological check recorded for overnight fall. No distress.
Resident fell in main hallway near elevator at 16:00. Unwitnessed.
Post-fall assessment completed for afternoon hallway event. Skin tear dressed on right forearm.

description: Two distinct falls within 5 hours of each other on the same shift.

notes.text: Resident slipped from wheelchair onto floor in activity room at 13:00.
Post-fall assessment completed for wheelchair slide at 13:00. No injuries noted.
Second fall today: Resident found on floor beside bathroom at 17:45. Immediate assistance given.
Post-fall assessment initiated for 17:45 bathroom incident. Neuro checks stable.

description: Explicit negation and historical fall risks without any new incident.

notes.text: Resident has a history of falls prior to admission. High fall risk identified on Morse scale.
Fall precautions implemented: non-skid socks provided, low bed positioned, call light in reach.
Resident denies any falls or near-misses during shift. Ambulated with 1-person assist without incident.

description: Resident with documented fall history and denial, who later suffers a genuine active fall at 21:00.

notes.text: Shift report: Resident slept soundly. Denies overnight falls or pain.
Physical therapy note: Patient has chronic history of frequent falls at home. Fall risk care plan reviewed.
Resident fell in bedroom at approx 21:00 while attempting unassisted transfer to commode.
Post-fall assessment completed for 21:00 commode fall. Pain rated 2/10 in right hip.

description: Controlled descent vs fall where fall was clinically ruled out.

notes.text: Resident found sitting on floor in hallway. States she felt dizzy and intentionally lowered herself to carpet.
RN evaluation: Controlled lower to floor by resident, no loss of consciousness. Fall ruled out after assessment.

description: Initial note reports unwitnessed bedside fall, amended later by nurse clarifying true location and witnessed slip.

notes.text: Resident found on floor beside bed at 01:30. Stated they slipped while reaching for eyeglasses.
Late entry / Correction: Resident was found in hallway bathroom, not bedside. Slip was observed by aide.
Post-fall assessment completed for corrected 01:30 bathroom slip. No injury detected.

description: Staff disagree on exact timing of fall (04:00 vs 05:15) but refer to identical overnight occurrence.

notes.text: Resident fell beside wardrobe at approximately 04:00. Call light placed.
Addendum to prior note: Incident occurred at approx 05:15, not 04:00. Vitals taken immediately.
Post-fall assessment completed for overnight wardrobe incident. Alert and oriented.

description: Compliant post-fall assessment documented within 30 minutes with detailed clinical exam.

notes.text: Resident tripped over door threshold and fell in dining foyer at 10:00.
Post-fall assessment completed: vitals stable, bilateral pupils PERRLA, skin intact, zero head trauma.

description: Two falls in one day where only Incident 1 has post-fall assessment, Incident 2 lacks it.

notes.text: Incident 1: Resident fell in room at 08:00.
Post-fall assessment completed for 08:00 morning fall. Vitals WNL.
Incident 2: Resident found on floor beside nurse station at 19:15. Staff helped resident up.
